items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had another brother that went in also. Vin went in.

ctx.x: Do you remember where he served or what country he was in?

I’m not too sure on all that. Because I had another brother that went in also. Vin went in. But Vin was drafted. I think the situation with my oldest brother Douglas, they picked him up somewhere, to go in. I was very young then and into the music, so I wasn’t following that. But I think later on he told me. He had a hard time.
So how did you get out of the Army?
